selection_override.reason: The macro mean is at ceiling (most families 100% for every candidate) and its differences come from one family, Kandinsky watch images; the rule's pick won on the dimension tie-break. The override is the candidate best on every product measure: OpenAI 419/429 and Google 626/637 caught when held out, real eBay FAKE 38/1416, COCO hold-out FAKE 1.7%. Its cost: Kandinsky held out 1265/1669. This is a post-hoc development choice; benchmark_v7 remains the one confirmatory test.
